text.text_excerpt: WooHoo, best philly cheese staks I have had in New Orleans. These guys are between the McDonalds and the old Pizza Hut on Claiborne, I got carry out for the first time from there and wow it was good. They are not dripping grease like most cheese steaks and the bread is great. Many times the sub rolls on cheese staks are huge and you end up with too much bread, not the case here. WARNING, they spice their meat and it has a bit of kick. Definately give these guys a shot if you are in the area.

Driving down Claiborne, I've always noticed Phillys Cafe but have yet to try it. My boyfriend, a lover of cheesesteaks, was itching to go. We finally went and were pleasantly surprised! The cheesesteaks were delicious! You can get a 7" or a 12" depending on your appetite. The cheesesteaks come dressed with lettuce, tomatoes, mayonnaise, bell peppers, onion, and mushrooms. They also serve breakfast as well as other sandwiches. This place is nothing fancy, but the service is great. If you're craving a cheesesteak, you have to check out Phillys Cafe.

Love there Philly cheesesteak. And the guy at the counter is always pleasant,service is quick and i love how i can watch them prepare my order. ladies that work the grill are clean and fast. Atmosphere isn't that great but the sandwiches always hit the spot.
